basic_info.description: Beautifully remodeled Bernal Heights home with three bedrooms, two full baths, approx. 1,198 sqft, and one car parking. Details include hardwood floors throughout, multiple skylights, a desirable open floor plan, and contemporary finishes. The high-end kitchen has been designed with a Wolf range, dual ovens, built-in appliances, quartz counters, and Poggenpohl European cabinetry. The kitchen seamlessly flows into the dining area and living room, which features a fireplace, large windows, and built-in shelving. The two bedrooms on the main level overlook the garden below and share a full bath complete with a walk-in shower. The primary suite occupies the lower level and includes an en-suite bathroom with a soaking tub and direct access to the garden through a set of french doors. The backyard is drenched in sunlight and includes a deck, low-maintenance turf, and landscaping. Completing the home is a spacious garage that can accommodate one car, additional storage, and laundry. Located on a quiet street within a few blocks of Cortland Ave with easy access to the weekly Farmer's Market and nearby freeways.
